stations.title: Order page
stations.note: The page waits for an answer.

stations.title: Proof handler
stations.note: Nobody can say where it stopped.

stations.title: Hesper
stations.say: So that was the proof route.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, a customer asks the order page for the proof of order 1873.
Sefton's proof handler never answers, so the page spins and nobody knows why.
You add middleware, one place for errors and a check on every step, in three tasks.
Now the page gets an answer at once, and it names the route that stopped.
Staff checks, errors and stuck steps all go through the router, in one place.
